subject.title: Dashboard: action-form widget — buttons and forms that dispatch the agent

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled dashboard action-form widget that dispatches parameterized prompts, and should the open linked PR remain the vehicle after its security, storage, dependency, conflict, and proof blockers are repaired?
rationale: This is a new dashboard-to-agent dispatch surface, not a broken existing contract, and automation cannot approve the product boundary or the security/storage exceptions needed for a bundled implementation.

options.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard substrate plus the linked action-form PR to clear security, storage, dependency, conflict, and proof concerns before implementation is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor a repaired bundled builtin
options.body: A repository owner can explicitly sponsor the first-party action-form direction and require a narrower, reviewed implementation that reuses `chat.send`, confirmation, shared rate limiting, and adversarial interpolation tests.

options.title: Move to external plugin direction
options.body: If maintainers do not want prompt-dispatching dashboard widgets bundled, route the capability to a plugin or ClawHub package after confirming the current plugin APIs are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard substrate plus the linked action-form PR to clear security, storage, dependency, conflict, and proof concerns before implementation is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses product direction, security posture, plugin boundaries, and repository ownership policy; `steipete` is the strongest official routing signal from CODEOWNERS and permissions.
